description: This file implements a simple text aggregator class (SimpleTextAggregator) used for basic sentence boundary detection in text streams, likely for Text-to-Speech (TTS) applications. It accumulates text until an end-of-sentence marker is detected, using a lookahead approach to avoid false sentence boundaries.

classes.name: SimpleTextAggregator
classes.description: A text aggregator that accumulates characters until it detects the end of a sentence, then yields the sentence as an Aggregation object. It handles lookahead logic to accurately identify sentence boundaries.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes an instance of SimpleTextAggregator with an empty text buffer and lookahead flag.

methods.name: Aggregation text(self)
methods.description: Returns the current accumulated text as an Aggregation object with type SENTENCE.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[Aggregation] aggregate(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character by character, yielding complete sentences when detected.

methods.name: Optional[Aggregation] _check_sentence_with_lookahead(self, char: str)
methods.description: Internal method that checks if the current text ends a sentence, utilizing lookahead to disambiguate punctuation.

methods.name: Optional[Aggregation] flush(self)
methods.description: Returns any remaining accumulated text as the last sentence, clearing the buffer.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Clears the text buffer in case of processing interruption.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets internal state, clearing accumulated text and lookahead flag.

ctags.name: aggregate
ctags.pattern: /^    async def aggregate(self, text: str) -> AsyncIterator[Aggregation]:$/
